translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' yell Rómana'

content: ¿Bera ka iṉacho c̱he dii x̱ozxto'cho Abrahama'? Nak gok biyake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lao Chioza'.
Sheḻ'ka' biyak dii Abrahama' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lao Chioza' ni c̱heyi diika' bene', zaklja bshalj bshone' lao beṉ' yell-lioni, per aga lao Chioza'.
Ḻa' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' nan: “Dii Abrahama' wyajḻi'e c̱he Chioza', na' Chioza' wne' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'.”
Kat' to wen llin chkaa laxje', bi nakan to dii chzani beṉ' cho'ene', san nakan dii chiyaḻ'kz wi'ene'.

Per shi to beṉ' shajḻi'e c̱he Chios, beena' chiyon beṉ' saaxyana' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao', Chioza' ile'ile'ne' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa gonḻilalleene', ḻa'kzi bibi bene' kwenc̱he idoḻee yeḻ' goklen c̱he Chioza'.
Dii Davina' bi'e dill' c̱he yeḻ' mbalaz c̱he beena' na Chioza' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' ḻa'kzi bibi bene' kwenc̱he bdoḻile'n.
Ki wna dii Davina':

content.text: na' ba biyol binit saaxya c̱he'na'.
Chakomba beena' bi yizi' X̱ancho Chioza'ne' kwent.

content: ¿Achakile to beṉ'ka' yoozgake' seṉ daa le circuncisión wak soagake' mbalaz? Bi nakan ka', san ḻekzka' beṉ'ka' bi yoo seṉna' wak soagake' mbalaz. Ḻa' ba wniakz' Chioza' wne' dii Abrahama' goke' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na' daa wyajḻi'e c̱he'.
Na' ¿batran wna Chioza' ka'? ¿Aba wyoo dii Abrahama' seṉna' kana' wna Chioza' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'? ¿Awa biṉ' sho'en? Chioza' wne' ka' kana' biṉ' sho'en.

Na'techlə wloo kwine' seṉ daa le circuncisión na' seṉna' bli'n ba nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lao Chioza' daa benḻilalleene'. Daan, dii Abrahama' nake' x̱ozxto' yog' beṉ' nak beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lao Chioza' daa nonḻilall'gake'ne', ḻa'kzi bi yoogake' seṉna'.

Na' dii Abrahama' ḻekzka' nake' x̱ozxto' neto' yoonto' seṉ daa le circuncisión. Per aga daa yoonto' seṉna'zan, san daa nonḻilall'nto' Chioza', beena' ba nonḻilall' dii Abrahama' kana' zi' sho'e seṉna'.

Chioza' bc̱hebe' gaki c̱he dii Abrahama' len xiiṉ dia c̱he'ka' doxen yell-lioni. Na' bc̱hebe' wi'en ḻegake' aga daa bengake' doxen ka na ley c̱he dii Moisézan', san daa benḻilall' dii Abrahama' Chiozan', wna Chioza' nake' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'.
Ḻa' sheḻ' to beṉ'ka' chonz ka na leyan' gaki c̱hegake' daa bc̱heb Chioza' wi'e dii Abrahama', bibi zjanayin gonḻilall'cho Chioza' na' aga bi zakii daa bc̱hebe' gone', sheḻ'ka'.
Leya' nsa'n yeḻ' zak'zi' c̱he beṉ'ka' bi chon ka nan. Per shi bibi ley de, aga bi de dii iṉan napgake' doḻ'.

Ka nak daa bc̱heb Chioza' gone' c̱he dii Abrahama', nakan to goklen daa chone' c̱he nottez beṉ' nonḻilalleene' kwenc̱he yog'zə xiiṉ dia c̱he'ka' ikaagake' daa we' Chioza' ḻegake'. Bi nakan c̱he to beṉ'ka' chonz ka na leya', san ḻekzka' nakan c̱he nottezə beṉ' chonḻilall' Chioza' ka benḻilall' dii Abrahama' ḻe'. Ḻa' dii Abrahama' nake' x̱ozxto' yog'cho cho' nonḻilall'chone'.
Ka na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza': “Ba nzoa' li' kwenc̱he gako' x̱axṉa' beṉ' zan inlleb.” Na' Chioza', beena' benḻilall' dii Abrahama', nape' yeḻ' wak yisbane' beṉ' wetka' na' wx̱e wsile' diika' biṉ' gak.

Kana' bich non dii Abrahama' lez soa xiiṉe', wyajḻi'e daa goll Chioza'ne' na' bene' lez gak ka golle'ne'. Ka' gok biyake' x̱ozxto' beṉ' zan inlleb, kon ka goll Chioza'ne', chi'e: “Kan' shesh shan xiiṉ dia c̱ho'ka'.”
Biga gokc̱hoplallee c̱he Chioza', ḻa'kzi chakbe'ile' ba nake' beṉ' golə par soa xiiṉe', ḻa' ba zoa gakile' to guiyoa yizan. Na' ni bi gokc̱hoplallee ḻa'kzi gok dii Sárana' nool will.
Bi gokc̱hoplallee, san zizikli benḻilallee gak daa bc̱heb Chioza' gone' na' be'laweene'.
Ḻa' wṉezile' kwasḻoḻ Chioza' nape' yeḻ' wak kwenc̱he gone' yog' diika' chc̱hebe'.
Daan ble'i Chioza'ne' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa wyajḻi'e c̱he'.
Na' daa nan “Chioza' ble'ile'ne' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'”, aga c̱he tozen' nan ka',
san ḻekzka' cho'en dill' c̱hecho cho' nonḻilall'cho Chioza', beena' bisbane' X̱ancho Jesucrístona' ladj beṉ' wetka', ḻa' lenchon chle'i Chioza' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa nonḻilall'chone'.
Bzani Chioza' X̱ancho Jesucrístona' wite' ni c̱he saaxya c̱hechoka' na' bisbane'ne' ladj beṉ' wetka' kwenc̱he biyakcho beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' lawe'na'.
